Vertical slice completion contract and representative scope

contract.summary: Apply every approved system contract and prohibition while implementing one representative sword-to-customer-to-same-UID return path.

current_decisions.title: Versioned item UID, ledger, and save envelope

contract.summary: Persist the same item identity, random seed, immutable birth facts, and append-only change ledger in a versioned Godot save envelope.

current_decisions.title: Representative primary materials and explicit tradeoffs

contract.summary: Use iron, silver, and meteor iron as primary materials only; do not reintroduce a secondary-material slot.

current_decisions.title: Five-grade vertical-slice birth roll preset

contract.summary: Map the three-zone direct-forging result to a persisted one-time five-grade birth roll; legendary remains possible only at the highest input tier and remains rare.

current_decisions.title: Initial attack, artistry, weight, and function-capacity preset

contract.summary: Use direct-forging attack outputs 5/10/15 plus explicit material fit; calculate artistry and weight independently; grade does not multiply raw stats.

current_decisions.title: General enhancement demo range, risk, and pity

contract.summary: Limit the slice to +0 through +10; one input produces one result; failure consumes the attempt and may hold or downgrade, while destruction is excluded from this baseline slice.

current_decisions.title: +10 precision-enhancement exclusive output

contract.summary: At +10 choose exactly one of ATTACK_PACKAGE, LIGHTWEIGHT, or FUNCTION_REWORK; the same milestone cannot be rerolled.

current_decisions.title: Representative Salamander catalyst seed lineage

contract.summary: Use salamander_core only as the representative catalyst; create an EMBER_TOUCHED seed in CATALYST_AFFIX and optionally consume one function-capacity point for ELEMENTAL_WARD(FIRE).

current_decisions.title: Three-customer explainable-fit roster

contract.summary: Use a gladiator, soldier, and ceremonial noble to expose attack demand, balanced reliability, artistry requirement, fire-function fit, and the binary maximum-weight gate.

current_decisions.title: Schedule result, damage, repair, chronicle, and playtest gate

contract.summary: Resolve one customer schedule and one announced world schedule, append the result to the same UID, allow one repair decision, and keep human playtest evidence separate from automated validation.
